name: Ho May Park
summary: A cable car over the hills to a Big Mountain park: take half a day for the view or the rides. The scenic ticket, adults 100,000 VND, is the round trip and the Royal Garden viewpoint. The full ticket, adults 475,000 VND, adds the rides. Skip it if Back Beach and the Christ statue already fill your day.
timeNeeded: Half a day if the rides are the point
fee: 100,000 VND scenic, or 475,000 VND full visit
heroCaption: A Ho May cabin on the line toward Big Mountain

notice.title: Two tickets, two prices
notice.body: The scenic ticket is the round trip and the Royal Garden viewpoint. The full ticket adds the rides. Buy the one that matches your visit.

body: The lower station is at 1A Trần Phú, on the Big Mountain shore road. The cabins ride over the hills to the park at the top, about 250 metres up, and pair a beach day with a mountain view.
The park is open 8:00–22:00, and the rides run 8:00–18:00. There is a show at 10:30–11:00, and on Saturdays and holidays a water show at 18:00. Go in the daytime if the view is what you came for.

figures.caption: The lower station on Trần Phú, with the cable leaving the building
figures.alt: Ho May cable-car station in Vung Tau, cables running up the hill

gettingThere: The lower station is 1A Trần Phú. Take a taxi or motorbike taxi from either beach, or walk along Trần Phú from Bach Dinh.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: North along Trần Phú to the station.

legs.heading: From Back Beach
legs.body: Across the peninsula by taxi or motorbike taxi to 1A Trần Phú.

admissionNote: Scenic cable car: adults 100,000 VND, children 50,000 VND, for the round trip and the Royal Garden viewpoint. Full visit: adults 475,000 VND, children 237,500 VND, with the rides. The child price is for 1 m to 1.3 m; under 1 m is free.
